summary: Firefox’s WebIDL layer is catching up with several web standards, including Permissions Policy, streaming Request bodies through ReadableStream and duplex uploads, WebTransport statistics and reliable-only connections, and WebGPU transient attachments. The Web Speech API receives more spec-aligned interfaces and error handling, while the Sanitizer API, WebCrypto, WebSerial, WebRTC, and SVG interfaces get compatibility and correctness updates. These bindings expose the right shapes and controls to web developers so sites can work more consistently across browsers.
